purpose: B61 (docs/OSS_CORPUS.md, docs/ANALYSIS_TESTS.md): Target.actions read outside analysis tests, by an attribute aspect that propagates (its base targets analyzed earlier, by a select() on a Starlark flag, without the aspect), by hasattr(), by a rule implementation (ctx.attr.dep.actions) and by a top-level aspect; and the merged target of an aspect over an aspect that registered actions (that aspect's actions first). Also a rule reading Target.actions and then the deferred target platform (no --platforms: the default host platform), and readers of 40 targets' actions (a rule and an aspect). Genuine Bazel 9.3.1 capture; tests/aspects.rs target_actions_outside_analysis_tests_like_bazel asserts these bytes and the print counts.

outputs.bazel-bin/c.actions:
b hasattr=True
b FileWrite argv=None -> b.txt
b LibCopy argv=["/bin/bash", "-c", "cp $1 $2", "", "bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/b.txt", "bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/b.copy"] -> b.copy
a hasattr=True
a FileWrite argv=None -> a.txt
a LibCopy argv=["/bin/bash", "-c", "cp $1 $2", "", "bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/a.txt", "bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/a.copy"] -> a.copy
